title: TRITON-CM: A Study to Evaluate Nucresiran in Patients with Transthyretin Amyloidosis with Cardiomyopathy
official: TRITON-CM: A Phase 3 Global, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Nucresiran in Patients with Transthyretin-Mediated Amyloidosis with Cardiomyopathy (ATTR amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy)
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the efficacy of nucresiran compared to placebo on reducing all-cause mortality and CV events
conditions: Transthyretin Amyloidosis with Cardiomyopathy (ATTR Amyloidosis with Cardiomyopathy)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Age 18 (or age of legal consent per local regulations, whichever is older) to 85 years, inclusive.
2. 2. Documented diagnosis of ATTR amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy, classified as either hATTR amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy or wtATTR amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy:
3. 3. Medical history of HF with at least 1 prior hospitalization for HF OR clinical evidence of HF (with or without hospitalization)
4. 4. Patients may be receiving approved TTR stabilizers for ATTR amyloidosis. Patients may be receiving background therapy for HF but must be stable for at least 30 days prior to screening
5. 5. Patient is clinically stable, with no CV-related hospitalizations within 6 weeks prior to randomization
6. 6. Screening NT-proBNP >300 ng/L and <8500 ng/L; in patients with permanent or persistent atrial fibrillation, Screening NT-proBNP >600 ng/L and <8500 ng/L
7. 7. Patient is able to understand and is willing and able to comply with the study requirements and to provide written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Has known primary amyloidosis (AL amyloidosis) or leptomeningeal amyloidosis
2. 10. Female patient is pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding
3. 11. Unwilling or unable to limit alcohol consumption, with a history of alcohol use disorder within the last 12 months, or a history of illicit drug use within the past 5 years that could interfere with study compliance
4. 2. NYHA Class IV HF; or NYHA Class III heart failure AND ATTR Amyloidosis Disease Stage 3 (defined as NT-proBNP >3000 ng/L and eGFR <45 mL/min)
5. 3. Has a polyneuropathy disability Score IIIa, IIIb, or IV at the Screening visit.
6. 4. Has any of the following lab parameter at screening: a. AST or ALT levels ˃2.0×ULN; b. Total bilirubin >2.0×ULN; c. INR >1.5 (unless patients were on anticoagulant therapy in which case excluded if INR ˃3.5).
7. 5. Has an eGFR of <30 mL/min/1.73m2 at screening (calculation will be based on the CKD-EPI equation)
8. 6. Has known HIV infection or evidence of current or chronic HCV or HBV infection.
9. 7. Patients with current, prior or planning to receive TTR-lowering therapy, anti-TTR antibody treatment, diflunisal, or participating in another investigational study (must meet washout periods of previous treatment to be included).
10. 8. Patients with the following medical conditions:  •	significant non-TTR cardiomyopathies, unstable CHF, recent acute coronary syndrome, ventricular arrhythmias, pacemaker-indicated nodal dysfunction, or uncontrolled high blood pressure are excluded from the study. •	untreated hypo- or hyperthyroidism •	active infections requiring systemic antiviral, antiparasitic, or antimicrobial therapy that will not be completed before dosing •	Prior or anticipated ( 12 months after randomization) organ transplant or implantation of LVAD •	multiple drug allergies or history of allergic reaction to any component of study drug •	intolerance to SC injection •	other medical conditions or comorbidities that could interfere with study compliance or data interpretation, or a life expectancy of <2 years due to any non-cardiovascular condition
11. 9. Unwilling to comply with the contraceptive requirements during the study;
